name: Thermometer Slider
description: A slider drawn as a glass thermometer whose liquid column springs to the value and shifts from water blue to camellia as it warms.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called continuously while the value changes.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Called when a drag or key press ends.

props.name: minValue
props.description: Value at the bulb end of the scale.

props.name: maxValue
props.description: Value at the far end of the scale.

props.name: step
props.description: Increment between values. Its decimals set how the value is written.

props.name: unit
props.description: Written after the value. °C and °F are also read out as Celsius and Fahrenheit.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Upright with the bulb at the bottom, or lying down with the bulb on the left.

props.name: length
props.description: Length of the scale in pixels. Vertical defaults to 200; horizontal fills its container.

props.name: coldColor
props.description: Colour of the liquid at the cold end. It passes through a neutral on the way to warmColor.

props.name: warmColor
props.description: Colour of the liquid at the warm end.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the slider and dims it to 50%.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Slider.
